critical_code_review_comments: server.py api_resolve_link() Doodstream branch: still calls doodapi file/check + file/info on every resolve; consider caching per file_code with a short TTL to avoid rate-limit exposure (doodapi 10/s).

resolve_mirror_links(): a single API failure inside api_resolve_link is logged but not retried; a transient rate-limit response can leave a link with status offline until the offline_checker cycles. Add bounded retry.
_voe_domain_cache remains a plain module-level dict with no lock; consider asyncio.Lock or single-flight to avoid duplicate settings/domain calls on cache miss.

Since Doodstream embed_url is now the canonical dsvplay.com URL, api_resolve_link() Doodstream branch no longer needs its probe_url() call for domain resolution - removing it would shave ~1s per resolve. If probe is only retained for a status signal, note that file/check already provides that.
